paragraphs: Before the event, verify ticket categories and seating charts and check tickets at windows and turnstiles. As guests enter, give directions and answer questions. During the event, patrol the venue, replenish refreshments, and watch coats. At the end, direct departing crowds and clear the venue. Hand over outstanding tasks at the end of each shift.
